title: This dog can go all night and never get tired 🐺❄️
caption:
Days of running. No crash. Scientists still can't fully explain it 🐺❄️
Tag the friend with endless energy 👇
sources: Davis M. S. et al. (2004) research on Iditarod sled dogs' metabolic adaptation (Oklahoma State University; funded in part by DARPA): glycogen depletion reverses after the first days, dogs shift to fat metabolism
Iditarod Trail Committee: about 1,000 miles; sled dogs may burn about 10,000-12,000 kcal a day during the race
